For a hotel conversion in Mexico, owners typically evaluate the following **collection or soft-brand families**:

| Parent company | Commonly considered brands | Typical positioning |
|---|---|---|
| **Marriott** | **The Luxury Collection**, **Autograph Collection**, **Tribute Portfolio** | Luxury through upper-upscale; strong Bonvoy distribution |
| **Hilton** | **LXR Hotels & Resorts**, **Curio Collection**, **Tapestry Collection** | Luxury through upscale; Curio and Tapestry are particularly conversion-oriented ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hiltons-curio-and-tapestry-collections-celebrate-200th-hotel-milestones?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hyatt** | **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt**, **JdV by Hyatt**, sometimes **Destination by Hyatt** | Luxury/upper-upscale, lifestyle and resort properties ([newsroom.hyatt.com](https://newsroom.hyatt.com/news-releases?item=124064&utm_source=openai)) |
| **IHG** | **Vignette Collection** | Luxury and upper-upscale independent hotels; explicitly designed as a conversion brand ([development.ihg.com](https://development.ihg.com/hotel-brands/vignette-collection?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Accor** | **Emblems Collection**, **MGallery Collection**, **Handwritten Collection** | Luxury, upper-upscale and midscale/upscale respectively; conversion-focused with flexible standards ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/news-stories/collection-brands-handwritten-emblems-mgallery?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Wyndham** | **Registry Collection Hotels**, **Trademark Collection by Wyndham** | Luxury resorts/all-inclusive and upscale conversions; both have an established Mexico presence ([wyndhamhotels.com](https://www.wyndhamhotels.com/trademark/locations?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Choice** | **Ascend Hotel Collection** | Upscale independent, historic, boutique and resort conversions; actively offered in Mexico ([franquiciaschoicehotels.com.mx](https://www.franquiciaschoicehotels.com.mx/es_mx/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **BWH Hotels** | **WorldHotels Luxury, Elite, Crafted or Distinctive**; **BW Premier Collection**; **BW Signature Collection** | Luxury through upper-midscale, depending on the collection ([bwhhotels.com](https://www.bwhhotels.com/content/developers/en_US/portfolio.html?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Posadas** | **Curamoria Collection** | Mexico-focused boutique collection that allows hotels to retain their identity while using Posadas’ distribution; offered through franchise arrangements ([cms.posadas.com](https://cms.posadas.com/documents/3110971/3167686/Reporte%20Anual%202025%20%2B%20Anexos.pdf/11c8974c-33f2-1f8b-6833-32d09a593e5b?utm_source=openai)) |

### Most frequent first-round shortlist

For a typical **upper-upscale boutique or resort conversion**, the initial comparison is often:

- Autograph Collection  
- Tribute Portfolio  
- Curio Collection  
- Tapestry Collection  
- Unbound Collection  
- Vignette Collection  
- MGallery  
- Trademark Collection  

For a **high-end luxury resort**, the shortlist usually shifts toward:

- The Luxury Collection  
- LXR  
- Vignette Collection  
- Emblems Collection  
- Registry Collection  
- WorldHotels Luxury  

For a **smaller upscale or regional hotel**, owners may focus on:

- Tapestry Collection  
- Tribute Portfolio  
- Handwritten Collection  
- Ascend Hotel Collection  
- BW Premier or Signature Collection  
- Trademark Collection  
- Curamoria Collection  

Owners wanting even greater independence may also compare these brands against **Preferred Hotels & Resorts, Leading Hotels of the World, or Small Luxury Hotels of the World**. These are affiliations rather than conventional franchise soft brands and generally provide distribution and marketing with less operating control. Preferred and SLH both represent independent properties in Mexico. ([slh.com](https://slh.com/about-slh?utm_source=openai))

The practical choice usually depends on the property’s **ADR target, room count, resort versus urban format, renovation scope, all-inclusive component, management structure, key money, territorial availability and required brand standards**.
